title: perf(app-shell): the in-app sidebar, the palette and recent rows name their items by name instead of loading whole metadata lists
body:
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbMtX15PqZB5jGttGLtxEfb2)_ Fixes #29235 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none Claim: 6575822841 · amendment: 6576916626 ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么:应用内侧边栏与命令面板给「没写 label 的导航项」取名时,改为按名字读那个对象/仪表盘,不再下载整张对象注册表;首页等处「最近访问」里的仪表盘、页面、报表行也改为按名字读单条,不再下载整张列表。 - 为什么改:一个导航项不写 label(规范允许,AI 生成的应用常见)时,进应用的每个页面都为取两个名字下载全部对象定义(app-crm 上 551 KB);最近访问里有一条仪表盘或页面,首页就下载整张仪表盘/页面列表。 - 风险与回滚:读法从「一次整表」变成「按名读单条」;应用内按名读由应用包(bundle)直接回答,不发请求。整表已被别处加载时一律直接用整表。显示的名字逐字不变(中英文均实测)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。 - 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useObjectPresence.ts`(新的 `useReadItemsByName`)、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useNavTargetLabel.ts`(仪表盘按名读)、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/chrome/CommandPalette.tsx`(面板取名改 byName)。 - 两分钟验证:打开一个导航项没写 label 的应用里的页面,开发者工具 Network 过滤 `meta/object`:不再有不带名字的 `GET /api/v1/meta/object`;侧边栏显示的名字与改前一致。 - 需要你做的:无,席位落地。 ## What changes Two label readers still downloaded a whole metadata list to name one row. Measured with CDP initiator stacks on a production Console (app-crm): | Reader | Before | Now | |---|---|---| | `UnifiedSidebar` (the in-app sidebar): an entry with no label of its own | `useNavTargetLabel()` read `metadata.objects`: the whole object registry and the `/meta/view` list | `useNavTargetLabel({ byName: true })`: the entry's object by name (the app bundle answers it, no request); a dashboard entry the bundle does not hold, by name | | `CommandPalette` (mounted closed in every app; it names each navigation entry on every render to build its lists) | `useNavTargetLabel()`, the same whole-list read, hidden behind the sidebar's by the provider cache | `useNavTargetLabel(RECENT_ROW_LABELS)`, the `{ byName: true }` constant the palette's recent rows already use | | `useRecentItemLabel`: a recent dashboard row | `metadata.dashboards` (through `useNavTargetLabel`'s `bundledFirst` fallback) | the dashboard by name | | `useRecentItemLabel`: a recent page row / report row | `metadata.pages` (behind `bundledFirst`) / `metadata.reports` | the page / report by name | `useReadItemsByName` (in `hooks/useObjectPresence.ts`, beside `readObjectsByName`) is the one helper for the non-object types. It asks through the provider's existing by-name read (`getItem`), so no provider or package export is added (`@object-ui/app-shell` is private). While nothing has loaded the type's list, each name is asked once and the reader re-renders as it lands. Once the list is loaded or loading, it reads the list and asks nothing. A hand-rolled context with no status or no `getItem` reads its list, as before. A name that answered an item is asked again after the provider's value changes (the provider's by-name cache answers it without a request, unless an invalidation dropped it, so a rename shows). A name that answered nothing is not asked again while the reader is mounted. `useNavTargetLabel({ byName: true })` now also reads a dashboard target the bundle does not hold by name. The other callers (Studio, search page, inspectors, `nav:menu`) are unchanged. `views/nav-menu-renderer.tsx` is the `nav:menu` page block, not the in-app sidebar, so it is untouched. ## Tests - `layout/__tests__/UnifiedSidebar.labelReadsByName-29235.test.tsx`: the real sidebar over the real `MetadataProvider` and a recording adapter. Unlabelled object and dashboard entries read `object/NAME` and `dashboard/NAME`, never the `object`, `view` or `dashboard` list. Labels pinned in en and zh-CN (inline locale maps). - `chrome/CommandPalette.navLabelReadsByName-29235.test.tsx`: the palette closed inside an app reads each entry's object by name and no list; opened, the entries show their objects' labels. - `hooks/__tests__/useRecentItemLabel.readsByName-29235.test.tsx`: dashboard, page and report rows ask their own item, never the list. Labels pinned in en, and in zh-CN through an inline locale map and a translation-bundle key. The machine name shows until the item lands, and for an item the server does not have (asked once). CONTROL: with the lists loaded, the rows read them and ask no item. ## Acceptance notes - **Claim amendment (6576916626):** `chrome/CommandPalette.tsx`, at the `:239` hook call only. The production re-measure showed it was the reader left in-app once the sidebar asked by name. - **Not changed, found while measuring:** - Inside a package-less app (one created in the console), `useNavMemberGates` reads its names-only scope with views, which reads the whole `/meta/view` list (7,014 B on app-crm). Outside an app, #29121 already asks it with `views: false`. - The same app's object routes read the whole object registry from `AppContent`: a package-less app has no object scope (`appObjectScope.ts`). So the in-app saving shows on its page routes, and on every route of a packaged app with unlabelled entries. - A page route for a page the app bundle does not hold reads the `/meta/page` list (`AppContent`'s page scope, prefer-local). - `openPathObjectReaders-12811`'s row for `useNavTargetLabel.ts` still reads "off" with a reason naming Home; the census stays green, and its prose is not updated here (outside the claim's surface). - A by-name read answers the item the server resolves for that name. The list read took the first item with that name. They differ only if two packages ship a same-named dashboard, page or report. ## Verification
Production Console, app-crm (objectstack dev --fresh), before (base b1779200) and after (head db585d60; later commits only move the by-name reader's asked set into a ref and merge main) Setup: an app `ops_app` saved through `PUT /api/v1/meta/app/ops_app` with three unlabelled entries (`crm_account`, `crm_contact`, `pipeline_dashboard`). Recent rows come from visiting a dashboard and a page. Playwright logs in, reloads each page with the cache disabled, and logs every `/api/` request with its CDP initiator stack. In-app page route `/apps/ops_app/page/crm_welcome`, en: - Before: 29 requests, 889,029 B, including `GET /api/v1/meta/object` (551,834 B) and `/meta/view` (7,014 B). The initiator is `get objects` from the `useNavTargetLabel` chunk, called from `ui-layout`'s `NavigationRenderer`. - After: 28 requests, 337,195 B. No `GET /api/v1/meta/object` without a name. `crm_account` and `crm_contact` are answered by the app bundle, with no request. - With only the sidebar changed, the object list was still read. Its initiator was `CommandPalette`'s `navLabel`, which led to the claim amendment. Home `/home`, with a recent dashboard row and a recent page row, en: - Before: 28 requests, 302,598 B, including `GET /api/v1/meta/dashboard` (5,596 B) and `/meta/page` (15,463 B). - After: 28 requests, 284,915 B, including `GET /api/v1/meta/dashboard/pipeline_dashboard` (3,054 B) and `/meta/page/crm_welcome` (1,044 B). The text shown is identical before and after: - Sidebar, en: `Account`, `Contact`, `Pipeline Dashboard`. - Sidebar, zh-CN: `客户`, `联系人`, `销售漏斗`. - Home recent rows, en: `CRM Welcome`, `Pipeline Dashboard`. - Home recent rows, zh-CN: `欢迎页`, `销售漏斗仪表盘`.
Ablations (each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored with git diff HEAD empty) - A1: the sidebar's `{ byName: true }` removed. Both sidebar cases red. - A2: the dashboard target reads `metadata.dashboards` again. Both sidebar cases and three recents cases red. - A3: a page row reads `metadata.pages`. Three recents cases red. - A4: a report row reads `metadata.reports`. Three recents cases red. - A5: an absent name asked again after each provider change. The "asked once" case red (re-run on the final head). - A6: the palette's `navLabel` resolver without `byName`. Both palette cases red.
Local runs - 220 test files naming the touched modules and their surfaces (`useNavTargetLabel`, `useRecentItemLabel`, `UnifiedSidebar`, `useObjectPresence`, `readObjectsByName`, `HomePage`, `RecentApps`, `CommandPalette`, `BuilderLanding`, `ConsoleLayout`, `HomeRail`), at `a3eaa1ec` under `os-verify-lock`, `--maxWorkers=2`, four batches: 220 files and 1,797 tests passed. After merging main (#29327 edits `CommandPalette.tsx`), the 77 `CommandPalette` and new-test files passed again at `fa2a8da5` (642 tests). CI's Test UI runs the rest of app-shell. - `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell`: 65/65 tasks. - `eslint --no-inline-config` on the changed files: 0 errors. The three hooks have no warnings. - Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`): 34 commands, all exit 0 at `fa2a8da5`, reconciled with `--ran` (34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED). The head `3dcde8cd` only merges main again (no touched file moved); on it the 35 sidebar, palette and new-test files (165 tests), app-shell type-check (65/65), `check-sdui-manifest` and `check-changeset-no-major` pass.
## Human Minimum - [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched) - [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. - [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. - [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. - [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. - [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched) - [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`. - [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. - [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) https://claude.ai/code/session_01QsR2jUpJJCdztFcegijAq7
